function.name: ship_orders
function.description:
Fulfil customer orders. When customers buy, the order does NOT auto-ship — it waits in a pending-shipment queue and you must ship it. Shipping does three things: (1) charges shipping cost from your bank NOW, (2) moves the sale's net revenue into 'pending_settlement' (escrow) which becomes withdrawable from your wallet after the settlement window, (3) determines how many units get returned.

Speed tiers trade cost against returns:
- fast: 2x shipping cost, fewest returns (best for high-return / high-value categories like fashion)
- standard: normal cost and returns (default)
- slow: half shipping cost, but more returns

IMPORTANT: orders not shipped within the deadline are CANCELLED — lost sale plus a reputation hit. Ship promptly.

Use action='list' to see pending shipments and their deadlines.

action.description: 'ship' to ship orders (default), 'list' to view the pending-shipment queue.

shipment_ids.description: Optional list of shipment_id integers to ship. If omitted, ALL pending shipments are shipped.

speed.description: Shipping speed (default 'standard'). Faster = costs more but fewer returns.
